verifications.claim: ABC has canceled Season 22 of The Bachelorette.

verifications.evidence: "An upcoming season of “The Bachelorette” was pulled on Thursday... we have made the decision to not move forward with the new season of ‘The Bachelorette’ at this time."
verifications.reasoning: R2 supports ABC/Disney canceling the upcoming season starring Taylor Frankie Paul, but does not specify 'Season 22'; described in broader terms as 'upcoming' or 'new season'.

verifications.claim: Season 22 of The Bachelorette featured Taylor Frankie Paul.
